_source: House rule. Who a character is on sight — gender and age — is not in the Cyberpunk RED book, which prints no age or gender mechanics. It is kept as a record the narrator reads so a stranger's first reaction to a 71-year-old man and a 22-year-old woman can differ, and so the narrator uses the pronouns the picture shows; it moves no die and no DV. The key is `sex` because that is what every saved character already carries; it holds male, female or nonbinary. A nonbinary person's noun carries their pronouns because 'person' alone would leave the narrator to pick one.
